patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks are frequently used, pairing large, impactful imagery or blank space with concise textual descriptions, creating dynamic visual balance.
The site employs an oversized, bold sans-serif typeface for hero and major section headings, creating a strong visual statement against a clean background.
A strictly monochromatic palette of white, light grey, and dark grey/black dominates the UI, with vibrant color introduced exclusively through project imagery and embedded media.
The initial hero text and image collage scroll upwards and out of view, smoothly transitioning to a minimalist sticky header as the user scrolls down the page.

Project showcase sections are presented as large, distinct blocks, often featuring a single dominant image or a pair of images, with minimal accompanying text, emphasizing visual impact and a curated portfolio.

technique_notes: The initial hero content, including a large text statement and an image collage, scrolls up and out of view, transitioning smoothly to a minimalist sticky header. Subsequent content sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.

The layout utilizes a flexible grid system that allows for large, impactful imagery to be paired with concise textual descriptions, often in an asymmetrical arrangement, to guide the eye and emphasize key projects.

A minimalist sticky header appears after scrolling past the hero, featuring a hamburger menu that expands into a full-screen overlay navigation, providing clear access to site sections without cluttering the main content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold hero text (~4-5x body) with large, bold section headings (~2-3x body) and smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (mostly square edges, with subtle rounding on some image containers and interactive elements).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal padding, creating a sense of openness and allowing content to breathe).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dynamic, image-rich hero that scrolls away to reveal a minimalist sticky header, combined with sophisticated scroll-triggered content reveals, creates a highly engaging and premium user experience. The bold, oversized typography against a clean, monochromatic backdrop also sets it apart from generic templates.
